overall_goal: Assemble the pizza by placing the dough on the peel and adding tomato sauce, mozzarella, aubergine, and egg.

goals.description: Prepare the pizza peel with semolina flour and place the dough on it.
goals.rationale: The person sets up the pizza peel, applies semolina flour to prevent sticking, and lays the stretched dough on it.

goals.description: Spread tomato sauce over the pizza dough.
goals.rationale: The person scoops tomato sauce onto the dough, spreads it evenly, and removes a stray piece of garlic.

goals.description: Prepare and distribute mozzarella chunks on the pizza.
goals.rationale: The person opens the mozzarella bag, drains the water, breaks the cheese into chunks, and scatters them over the pizza.

goals.description: Start adding aubergine chunks to the pizza.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly grabs handfuls of aubergine from a plate and places them evenly onto the pizza.

goals.description: Finish adding aubergine chunks to the pizza.
goals.rationale: The person continues to grab the remaining aubergine chunks and distributes them across the pizza.

goals.description: Add egg slices to the pizza.
goals.rationale: The person places slices of egg onto the pizza, adjusting the other toppings to make room.
